title: On Burying the dog under the fig tree
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：bury　|　正文 357 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 bury 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 the writer ① buried the dog under the fig tree in the rain, and every reader in the study said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the writer ② buries the dog under the fig tree without complaint without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ bury the dog under the fig tree at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ buried the dog under the fig tree before — a line in the manuscript for January 1966 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Burying the dog under the fig tree in the rain, the writer said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the page at the far shelf, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ bury the silver coins under the floor without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Bury the silver coins under the floor at once and never mention it again.

By 1979 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the manuscript, and a new reader from the next study ⑧ buries the silver coins under the floor in the rain every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the shelf, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ buried the dog under the fig tree again when nobody else would.

⑩ To bury the dog under the fig tree, my mother said in 1984, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the study remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the study forgets, somebody buries the dog under the fig tree without complaint again and somebody must bury the dog under the fig tree in the rain all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 埋葬（一般过去式 buried the dog under the fig tree：1972 年写作者头一回这样做，淋着雨）
B. v. 埋葬（一般现在 buries the dog under the fig tree：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 埋葬（不定式 to bury the dog under the fig tree：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 埋葬（过去完成时 had buried the dog under the fig tree：1966 年一月的手稿上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 埋葬（动名词 burying the dog under the fig tree 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 埋藏（bury the silver coins under the floor：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去埋藏把银钱埋在地板下）
G. v. 埋藏（bury the silver coins under the floor：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 埋葬（后段两处：新来的读者照例 buries the silver coins under the floor，而母亲又一次 buried the dog under the fig tree）

bury 意为“埋葬”，自那以后写作者毫无怨言地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 buries。
bury 意为“埋葬”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯埋葬把那只狗埋在无花果树下”，此处为不定式 to bury the dog under the fig tree。
bury 意为“埋葬”，手稿里 一月 那行字说明早在 1979 年之前就有人埋葬过，故用过去完成时 had buried。
bury 意为“埋葬”，写作者说“埋葬把那只狗埋在无花果树下这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 burying the dog under the fig tree 作主语。
bury 意为“埋藏”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去埋藏把银钱埋在地板下”，should ever 之后用原形 bury the silver coins under the floor。
bury 意为“埋藏”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻埋藏把银钱埋在地板下（bury the silver coins under the floor at once），以后再也不要提起。
bury 意为“埋葬”，新来的读者每个月份都照例埋藏把银钱埋在地板下，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 buries。
bury 意为“埋葬”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次淋着雨埋葬把那只狗埋在无花果树下，用一般过去式 buried 叙述。
bury 意为“埋葬”，结尾那句是母亲 1984 年的话：要埋葬把那只狗埋在无花果树下，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和书斋记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 bury 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1972 the writer buried the dog under the fig tree in the rain, and nobody in the study forgot it.
Even now the writer buries the dog under the fig tree without complaint whenever the study asks.
Burying the dog under the fig tree in the rain, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever bury the silver coins under the floor without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new reader from the next study buries the silver coins under the floor in the rain every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother buried the dog under the fig tree again, and the study remembered that half.
